title: Telemetry ops
description: Is the demo's data fresh? Synthetic data (simulator -> Redpanda -> consumer), real data (Airflow ingest jobs), and the database. Read-only; provisioned from infra/grafana/dashboards.

panels.title: Synthetic data: seconds since last write
panels.description: Per table, how long ago the consumer last wrote a row (ingested_at). The simulator publishes about once a second, so anything over a few minutes means the simulator, Redpanda or the consumer has stopped. Empty = never written (placeholder model).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS "table", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last)::int AS "seconds ago"
FROM (
  SELECT 'state_snapshot' AS t, max(ingested_at) AS last FROM state_snapshot
  UNION ALL SELECT 'thermal_output', max(ingested_at) FROM thermal_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'power_output', max(ingested_at) FROM power_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'comms_output', max(ingested_at) FROM comms_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'radiation_output', max(ingested_at) FROM radiation_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cross_model_state', max(ingested_at) FROM cross_model_state
  UNION ALL SELECT 'telemetry_packet', max(ingested_at) FROM telemetry_packet
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ml_feature_vectors', max(ingested_at) FROM ml_feature_vectors
  UNION ALL SELECT 'anomaly_events', max(ingested_at) FROM anomaly_events
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Real data: last ingested
panels.description: When each ingest job last wrote its table. The daily refresh (DONKI, GOES protons, JPL CAD) runs at 00:00 UTC, so over 36 h means it failed: see the Airflow UI. Backfill tables change only when the real_data_backfill DAG is run by hand.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS "table", schedule, last AS "last written",
       round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS "hours ago"
FROM (
  SELECT 'close_approaches (JPL CAD)' AS t, 'daily' AS schedule, max(ingested_at) AS last FROM close_approaches
  UNION ALL SELECT 'donki_events (NASA DONKI)', 'daily', max(fetched_at) FROM donki_events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'goes_integral_protons (NASA iSWA)', 'daily', max(ingested_at) FROM goes_integral_protons
  UNION ALL SELECT 'orion_ephemeris (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at) FROM orion_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'moon_ephemeris (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at) FROM moon_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dsn_site_geometry (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at) FROM dsn_site_geometry
  UNION ALL SELECT 'oem_state_vectors (NASA OEM)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at) FROM oem_state_vectors
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mission_events (timeline)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at) FROM mission_events
) s
ORDER BY schedule DESC, 1

panels.title: Synthetic rows written per minute (state_snapshot)
panels.description: Rows the consumer wrote per minute. A flat line at zero = the pipeline stopped; a gap = the database was unreachable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ingested_at) AS time, count(*) AS "rows per minute"
FROM state_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Airflow: latest DAG runs
panels.description: The 15 most recent runs of the ingest DAGs (real_data_refresh: daily; real_data_backfill: by hand). Details and logs: the Airflow UI.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dag_id AS "DAG", run_type AS "type", state, start_date AS "started",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date - start_date)::int AS "seconds"
FROM dag_run
ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Rows per table
panels.description: Exact row counts of every table in the telemetry database (the tables are small).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT table_name AS "table",
       (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS c FROM %I.%I', table_schema, table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS "rows"
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of the telemetry and airflow databases (the managed plan has 10 GiB).
